sprint_goal: Ship all four v7.5 UI feature expansions — global command palette, user-defined price alerts, bulk actions, and saved filters/calendar view — each fully wired to its now-locked design artefact and observable in the running app.

ST-01.title: Wire global Cmd/Ctrl-K command palette
ST-01.notes: Reclassified from sprint_backlog.md's placeholder delegated_frontend to autonomous per LL-v2.3-CL-01 (frontend default-autonomous model) — existing shadcn Command primitive at src/components/ui/command.js is unwired but present; spec is locked; no external frontend ownership genuinely required. All 3 AC verified live: npm install added cmdk (readiness-pass-flagged gap), dev server started and all 12 Playwright scenarios (SC-CP-01..12) run against it and pass; keyboard-shortcuts/smoke/sidebar-nav-groups regression suites re-run clean (20 passed, 2 pre-existing skips unrelated to this change). Deviation check: implementation intent matches spec throughout with one noted divergence — ux_spec.md assumed a `/trade-plans/{id}` path-param detail route; the app's actual TradePlan detail route is query-param based (`/TradePlan?edit={id}&ticker=...&market=...`, confirmed via TradePlans.js's existing Edit-button navigation). Intent (navigate directly to that plan's detail view, ID already known) matches — per LL-v3.4-P3-03 this is recorded as an implementation note, not a filed spec deviation. Also fixed a pre-existing bug in src/utils/index.js createPageUrl (TradePlan/TradePlans routes were missing from the map, so page-name navigation to either would have silently redirected to '/') — necessary for AC-3 to hold for all pages.js PAGES entries, not scope creep.

ST-02.title: Add user-created price-alert data model, UI, and delivery integration
ST-02.notes: Reclassified from sprint_backlog.md's placeholder delegated_frontend to autonomous per LL-v2.3-CL-01 — backend data model, evaluation-pipeline extension, and health-check surfacing are pre-scoped and locked (readiness pass, §13 PASS 2026-07-16), so engine can implement both frontend CRUD and backend integration directly. All 3 ACs implemented: price_alerts table (data_model.md v2.12->v2.13), GET/POST /price-alerts + DELETE /price-alerts/{id} (alerts_endpoints.md v0.4->v0.5, openapi.yaml v3.10.0->v3.11.0, api_performance_baseline.md v2.13->v2.14), evaluation folded into POST /alerts/evaluate (_evaluate_price_alerts) with GET /health/scheduler custom_price_alerts job key, and CustomPriceAlertsSection.js mounted on NotificationPreferences.js. 11/11 new Playwright scenarios (tests/e2e/custom-price-alerts.spec.js) + 21/21 new backend unit scenarios (tests/test_price_alerts_service.py) pass; full regression clean (system-status/alert-thresholds-empty-state/notifications e2e specs 38/38; full backend pytest suite 694 passed, 2 pre-existing skips, 0 failed). test.py registered (89->92 endpoints); SystemStatus.js fallback and system-status.spec.js SC-SS-01b updated to 92 in the same commit (also corrected a pre-existing stale '84' placeholder that had drifted out of sync with test.py's actual count independently of this story). Deviation check: implementation intent matches spec throughout — no filed deviations. Staging-only AC (alert fires via live delivery channel) tracked via backlog item BLG-QA-115 (filed before PR opens per CLAUDE.md §2), not a spec deviation. Frontend-visible EPIC (CustomPriceAlertsSection.js, NotificationPreferences.js, SystemStatus.js) — BLG-GOV-19 autonomous class sign-off unavailable (Criterion 3 unmet per BLG-GOV-135); qa_evidence_EPIC-02.md written with full AC table and Standard Sign-Off Block, Date left blank pending Director of Quality (always-human gate per §5.3) — halting here, not an escalation.

ST-03.title: Add multi-select and bulk-action toolbar to Watchlist/TradePlans
ST-03.notes: Reclassified from sprint_backlog.md's placeholder delegated_frontend to autonomous per LL-v2.3-CL-01 — pure client-side interaction pattern against existing app data, spec locked. All 3 ACs implemented: shared BulkActionToolbar.js (checkbox selection, inline Bulk Tag, destructive confirmation, partial-failure toast); row checkboxes + header select-all on Watchlist and Trade Plans; 6 new batch endpoints (watchlist.md v1.0->v1.1, trade_plan_endpoints.md v0.6->v0.7, openapi.yaml v3.10.0->v3.11.0, api_performance_baseline.md v2.13->v2.14). New watchlist.tags column (data_model.md v2.12->v2.13). 12/12 new Playwright scenarios + 19/19 new backend unit scenarios pass; full regression clean (trade-plan.spec.js 52/52, system-status.spec.js 19/19, smoke-critical-paths.spec.js 3/3; full e2e suite 591 passed, 3 pre-existing skips; full backend pytest 692 passed, 2 pre-existing skips). test.py registered (89->95 endpoints); SystemStatus.js fallback and system-status.spec.js SC-SS-01b updated to 95. Two implementation notes (not filed deviations, intent matches spec per LL-v3.4-P3-03): (1) Watchlist Bulk Tag — readiness pass's 'reuse POST /positions/bulk-tag' mapping didn't fit (watchlist is pre-position, no positions relationship); built a dedicated tags column + POST /watchlist/bulk-tag instead, following the same per-entity pattern the readiness pass established for the other two entities. (2) Bulk Archive applies a fixed system abandonment reason since ux_spec.md's bulk confirm dialog defines no reason field (unlike the single-item Abandon modal). Drive-by fix: test.py's endpoint dispatcher only handled GET/POST/DELETE (PUT/PATCH always errored) -- added PUT/PATCH branches, required for this story's own bulk-archive registration to report pass. Installed @radix-ui/react-checkbox (previously-unwired scaffold component dependency, same pattern as EPIC-01's cmdk gap). No staging-only ACs -- frontend testing gate satisfied via Playwright alone. Frontend-visible EPIC -- BLG-GOV-19 autonomous class sign-off unavailable (Criterion 3 unmet); qa_evidence_EPIC-03.md written with full AC table and Standard Sign-Off Block, Date left blank pending Director of Quality (always-human gate per §5.3) -- halting here, not an escalation.

ST-04.notes: Reclassified from sprint_backlog.md's placeholder delegated_frontend to autonomous per LL-v2.3-CL-01 — placement decision (Trade History only) grounded in design gate; persistence testable via integration test, calendar via Playwright against seeded data.
